<thought>The dominant ion at m/z 276.0666 is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ≈275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+2 peak (~33 % of the base), characteristic of a single chlorine atom. Solving for integer numbers of C, H, O that match the neutral mass with one Cl gives the best‑fit formula C₁₅H₁₂O₃Cl (mass ≈ 275.047 Da, within typical experimental tolerance).</thought>
<final_answer>C15H12O3Cl</final_answer>
